dimensions.assessment: Affects specific Native American tribes and trust funds, including the Navajo Nation, Taos Pueblo, and Aamodt Settlement Pueblos.
Provides defined financial adjustments and interest payments for existing trust funds and water settlements.
Authorizes specific appropriations of $6,357,674.46, $7,794,297.52, and $4,314,709.18 for deposit into various trust funds.
dimensions.evidence: there is authorized to be appropriated for deposit in the Trust Fund $6,357,674.46

dimensions.assessment: Makes technical corrections to prior acts and authorizes specific interest payments and waivers without creating new programs.
Applies permanently through specific one-time funding authorizations and statutory amendments affecting past settlement acts.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes specific appropriations for trust funds totaling around 18.4 million dollars in adjusted interest payments and waives certain interest payments due to the United States.
